instruments.summary_en:
Demand-side gas policy shaping the market for Gippsland and Otway offshore gas.
- New homes requiring a planning permit must be all-electric from 1 January 2024
- Renewable Gas Directions Paper (December 2024); government response due 2026
- Building electrification regulations phased in from 1 January 2027
instruments.summary_zh:
需求侧天然气政策，影响Gippsland和Otway海上天然气的市场。
- 自2024年1月1日起，需规划许可的新建住宅须全电气化
- 2024年12月发布可再生燃气方向文件，政府回应预计2026年完成
- 建筑电气化法规自2027年1月1日起分阶段实施
instruments.recent_change_zh: 2025年：路线图更新发布；2026年7月页面更新。

instruments.title: Petroleum (Submerged Lands) Act 1982 (Tas)
instruments.title_zh: 《1982年石油（水下土地）法》（塔州）
instruments.summary_en:
Petroleum regime for Tasmanian coastal waters (0–3 nm).
- No petroleum production in Tasmanian waters
- Three of five 2025 Otway acreage areas lie in the offshore area of Tasmania (Commonwealth waters)
- Tasmanian Minister sits on the Joint Authority for adjacent Commonwealth waters
instruments.summary_zh:
塔州沿海水域（0–3海里）油气制度。
- 塔州水域无油气生产
- 2025年Otway招标5个区块中3个位于塔州外海（联邦海域）
- 塔州部长是相邻联邦海域联合主管机构成员

instruments.title: Living Marine Resources Management Act 1995 (Tas)
instruments.title_zh: 《1995年海洋生物资源管理法》（塔州）
instruments.summary_en:
Principal Tasmanian law for wild-catch fisheries.
- Individual transferable quota for southern rock lobster and abalone
- Management plans for scalefish, scallop and giant crab fisheries
- Licence fees and royalties fund management and research
instruments.summary_zh:
塔州野生捕捞渔业的基本法。
- 南方岩龙虾和鲍鱼实行个人可转让配额
- 鳞鱼、扇贝和巨蟹渔业实行管理计划
- 许可证费和资源费用于管理与科研

instruments.title: Marine Farming Planning Act 1995 (Tas)
instruments.title_zh: 《1995年海水养殖规划法》（塔州）
instruments.regulator: NRE Tasmania / Marine Farming Planning Review Panel
instruments.summary_en:
Spatial planning and leasing for marine farming.
- Marine farming development plans zone areas for salmon, shellfish and seaweed farming
- Independent Review Panel assesses plans and amendments
- Marine farming leases and licences set stocking, lease area and site rehabilitation conditions
instruments.summary_zh:
海水养殖空间规划与租赁制度。
- 海水养殖开发规划为三文鱼、贝类和海藻养殖划定区域
- 独立评审委员会审查规划及修订
- 海水养殖租约及许可证规定放养量、租用面积和场地恢复条件

instruments.title: Finfish Farming Environmental Regulation Act 2017 (Tas)
instruments.title_zh: 《2017年鱼类养殖环境监管法》（塔州）
instruments.summary_en:
Made the EPA the environmental regulator of salmon farming.
- Environmental licences for finfish farms set biomass limits, monitoring and reporting
- Covers marine and inland waters
- Development assessment remains under the Marine Farming Planning Act
instruments.summary_zh:
确立塔州EPA为三文鱼养殖环境监管机构。
- 鱼类养殖环境许可证规定生物量上限、监测和报告义务
- 覆盖海水及内陆水域
- 开发评估仍适用《海水养殖规划法》

instruments.title: Tasmanian Salmon Industry Plan 2023
instruments.title_zh: 《2023年塔州三文鱼产业计划》
instruments.summary_en:
Ten-year plan for the Tasmanian salmon industry.
- Covers environmental standards, biosecurity, transparency of farm data and community engagement
- Supports moving farming to offshore and land-based systems over time
- Macquarie Harbour operations shielded from EPBC reconsideration by the 2025 Commonwealth amendment
instruments.summary_zh:
塔州三文鱼产业十年计划。
- 涵盖环境标准、生物安全、养殖数据公开和社区沟通
- 支持养殖逐步转向离岸及陆基系统
- Macquarie Harbour养殖经2025年联邦修订免于EPBC复议
instruments.recent_change_en: 2025-03: Commonwealth Reconsiderations Act protects Macquarie Harbour approvals.
instruments.recent_change_zh: 2025年3月：联邦《复议》修订法保护Macquarie Harbour既有批准。

instruments.title: Environmental Management and Pollution Control Act 1994 (Tas)
instruments.title_zh: 《1994年环境管理与污染控制法》（塔州）
instruments.summary_en:
Tasmanian environmental assessment and pollution control law.
- Level 2 activities (e.g. fish processing, ports, large infrastructure) assessed by the EPA Board
- Environmental protection notices and permit conditions
- Applies to onshore elements of offshore wind, interconnectors and port upgrades
instruments.summary_zh:
塔州环境评估与污染控制法。
- 二级活动（如水产加工、港口、大型基础设施）由EPA委员会评估
- 环境保护通知及许可条件
- 适用于海上风电、互联线和港口改造的陆上部分

instruments.title: Nature Conservation Act 2002 (Tas) — marine reserves
instruments.title_zh: 《2002年自然保护法》（塔州）：海洋保护区
instruments.regulator: NRE Tasmania / Parks and Wildlife Service
instruments.summary_en:
Reserve classes include Tasmanian marine reserves in state waters.
- Marine reserves such as Maria Island, Tinderbox, Ninepin Point, Governor Island and Port Davey
- No-take restrictions in most reserves
- Threatened species listing interacts with salmon farm and port approvals
instruments.summary_zh:
保护区类别包括塔州州水域海洋保护区。
- 包括Maria岛、Tinderbox、Ninepin Point、Governor岛和Port Davey等海洋保护区
- 多数保护区禁捕
- 受威胁物种名录影响三文鱼养殖和港口审批

instruments.title: Aquaculture in adjacent Commonwealth waters (OCS arrangement)
instruments.title_zh: 相邻联邦海域水产养殖（海上宪政安排）
instruments.summary_en:
Pathway for Tasmania to regulate marine farming beyond 3 nm.
- Tasmanian marine farming law can apply in adjacent Commonwealth waters under OCS-style arrangements
- Enables offshore salmon farming trials beyond the state limit
- EPBC Act approval still required for impacts on national environmental matters
instruments.summary_zh:
塔州将海水养殖监管延伸至3海里以外的路径。
- 依海上宪政类安排，塔州海水养殖法可适用于相邻联邦海域
- 为州界以外的离岸三文鱼养殖试点提供依据
- 涉及国家环境事项仍须取得EPBC批准

instruments.title: Marine and Safety Authority Act 1997 and Tasmanian Ports Corporation Act 2005
instruments.title_zh: 《1997年海事安全局法》及《2005年塔斯马尼亚港口公司法》
instruments.summary_en:
Maritime safety and port governance in Tasmania.
- MAST regulates recreational and some commercial vessel safety and moorings, including aquaculture vessel operations
- TasPorts operates state ports including Bell Bay, Burnie and Devonport
- Bell Bay is a candidate base for Bass Strait offshore wind and green hydrogen
instruments.summary_zh:
塔州海事安全与港口治理。
- MAST规管休闲及部分商业船舶安全与系泊，包括养殖船作业
- TasPorts运营Bell Bay、Burnie、Devonport等州属港口
- Bell Bay是Bass Strait海上风电和绿氢的候选基地

instruments.title: Mineral Resources Development Act 1995 (Tas)
instruments.title_zh: 《1995年矿产资源开发法》（塔州）
instruments.summary_en:
Mineral tenure for Tasmania, including state coastal waters.
- Exploration and mining leases issued by MRT
- No seabed mining projects in Tasmanian waters
- Mining in reserves and marine reserves restricted
instruments.summary_zh:
塔州矿权制度，适用范围包括州沿海水域。
- MRT核发勘探及采矿租约
- 塔州水域无海底采矿项目
- 保护区及海洋保护区内采矿受限

instruments.title: Petroleum (Submerged Lands) Act 1982 (SA)
instruments.title_zh: 《1982年石油（水下土地）法》（南澳）
instruments.summary_en:
Petroleum regime for South Australian coastal waters (0–3 nm).
- No petroleum production in SA coastal waters
- Commonwealth Bight Basin permits off SA were relinquished after exploration plans were withdrawn
- SA Minister sits on the Joint Authority for adjacent Commonwealth waters
instruments.summary_zh:
南澳沿海水域（0–3海里）油气制度。
- 南澳沿海水域无油气生产
- 南澳外海联邦Bight盆地勘探许可在勘探计划撤回后已交回
- 南澳部长是相邻联邦海域联合主管机构成员

instruments.title: Energy Resources Act 2000 (SA) (formerly Petroleum and Geothermal Energy Act 2000)
instruments.title_zh: 《2000年能源资源法》（南澳）（原《石油与地热能源法》）
instruments.summary_en:
Onshore energy resources law covering petroleum, geothermal, hydrogen-related storage and GHG storage.
- 2021 amendments renamed the Act and added GHG storage licensing
- Enables the Moomba CCS project in the Cooper Basin
- Objective-based environmental regulation through Statements of Environmental Objectives
instruments.summary_zh:
陆上能源资源法，覆盖油气、地热、氢相关储存及温室气体封存。
- 2021年修订更名并新增温室气体封存许可
- 为Cooper盆地Moomba碳捕集与封存项目提供依据
- 通过环境目标声明实施目标导向的环境监管

instruments.title: Hydrogen and Renewable Energy Act 2023 (SA)
instruments.title_zh: 《2023年氢能与可再生能源法》（南澳）
instruments.summary_en:
Licensing regime for large-scale hydrogen and renewable energy projects on SA land and in SA coastal waters.
- Release areas and competitive allocation; feasibility, generation and infrastructure licences
- Regulations made in 2024 with fee notices
- Only state regime that expressly covers renewable generation in state coastal waters
instruments.summary_zh:
南澳陆上及沿海水域大型氢能与可再生能源项目许可制度。
- 设释放区及竞争性分配；可行性、发电及基础设施许可证
- 2024年制定配套条例及收费通知
- 目前唯一明确覆盖州沿海水域可再生能源发电的州级制度
instruments.recent_change_en: 2024: Hydrogen and Renewable Energy Regulations 2024 made.
instruments.recent_change_zh: 2024年：《2024年氢能与可再生能源条例》制定。

instruments.title: Fisheries Management Act 2007 (SA)
instruments.title_zh: 《2007年渔业管理法》（南澳）
instruments.summary_en:
Principal SA law for wild-catch fisheries.
- Quota for rock lobster and abalone; Spencer Gulf and Gulf St Vincent prawn fisheries under harvest strategies
- Marine scalefish fishery reformed with quota for key species
- Licence fees recover management costs
instruments.summary_zh:
南澳野生捕捞渔业的基本法。
- 岩龙虾和鲍鱼实行配额；Spencer湾和St Vincent湾对虾渔业实行捕捞策略
- 海洋鳞鱼渔业改革后对主要物种实行配额
- 许可证费回收管理成本

instruments.title: Aquaculture Act 2001 (SA)
instruments.title_zh: 《2001年水产养殖法》（南澳）
instruments.summary_en:
Dedicated aquaculture planning and licensing law.
- Aquaculture zone policies designate areas and capacity (e.g. Spencer Gulf, Eyre Peninsula)
- Separate leases (tenure) and licences (operations), with rehabilitation obligations
- Supports southern bluefin tuna ranching at Port Lincoln, oysters and yellowtail kingfish
instruments.summary_zh:
专门的水产养殖规划与许可法。
- 养殖区政策划定区域及容量（如Spencer湾、Eyre半岛）
- 租约（权属）与许可证（经营）分设，附场地恢复义务
- 支撑Port Lincoln南方蓝鳍金枪鱼育肥、牡蛎和黄尾鰤养殖

instruments.title: Environment Protection Act 1993 (SA)
instruments.title_zh: 《1993年环境保护法》（南澳）
instruments.summary_en:
SA pollution control and environmental licensing law.
- Licences for prescribed activities, including desalination brine discharge, fish processing and port operations
- Environment protection policies for water quality in gulfs
- Works alongside the planning EIS process
instruments.summary_zh:
南澳污染控制与环境许可法。
- 规定活动须持许可证，包括海水淡化浓盐水排放、水产加工和港口运营
- 海湾水质环境保护政策
- 与规划环评程序配合实施

instruments.title: Planning, Development and Infrastructure Act 2016 (SA)
instruments.title_zh: 《2016年规划、开发与基础设施法》（南澳）
instruments.regulator: Department for Housing and Urban Development / State Planning Commission
instruments.summary_en:
SA planning system, including impact-assessed (EIS) development.
- Major coastal projects (ports, desalination, hydrogen export facilities) assessed as impact-assessed development
- Planning and Design Code coastal overlays
- Aquaculture largely handled under the Aquaculture Act
instruments.summary_zh:
南澳规划体系，含需影响评估（EIS）的开发项目。
- 大型沿海项目（港口、海水淡化、氢能出口设施）按影响评估开发处理
- 《规划与设计准则》设海岸叠加管控
- 水产养殖主要适用《水产养殖法》

instruments.title: Marine Parks Act 2007 (SA)
instruments.title_zh: 《2007年海洋公园法》（南澳）
instruments.summary_en:
Establishes SA's 19 marine parks in state waters.
- Zoning: general managed use, habitat protection, sanctuary and restricted access zones
- Sanctuary zones prohibit fishing and extraction
- Constraint on aquaculture zones, ports and seabed activity
instruments.summary_zh:
设立南澳州水域19个海洋公园。
- 分区：一般管理利用区、栖息地保护区、禁捕保护区及限制进入区
- 禁捕保护区禁止捕捞及开采
- 对养殖区、港口和海床活动构成约束

instruments.title: Offshore Minerals Act 2000 (SA)
instruments.title_zh: 《2000年海上矿产法》（南澳）
instruments.summary_en:
Mineral titles in SA coastal waters, mirroring the Commonwealth Offshore Minerals Act.
- Exploration, retention and mining licences
- No operating seabed mines in SA waters
- Activity restricted in marine park sanctuary zones
instruments.summary_zh:
南澳沿海水域矿权制度，与联邦《海上矿产法》对应。
- 设勘探、保留及采矿许可证
- 南澳水域无在产海底矿山
- 海洋公园禁捕区内活动受限

instruments.title: Harbors and Navigation Act 1993 (SA)
instruments.title_zh: 《1993年港口与航行法》（南澳）
instruments.summary_en:
Governs SA harbors, navigation and marine safety.
- Main commercial ports operated by private lessees (Flinders Ports)
- Port Bonython and Whyalla relevant to hydrogen and resource export proposals
- Vessel safety and harbour master powers
instruments.summary_zh:
规管南澳港口、航行及海事安全。
- 主要商业港口由私营承租方（Flinders Ports）运营
- Port Bonython和Whyalla涉及氢能及资源出口项目
- 船舶安全与港务长职权

instruments.title: Water Industry Act 2012 (SA) — Adelaide Desalination Plant
instruments.title_zh: 《2012年供水行业法》（南澳）：阿德莱德海水淡化厂
instruments.summary_en:
Licensing and price regulation for SA water retailers, including SA Water's desalination assets.
- Adelaide Desalination Plant at Lonsdale, capacity 100 GL a year
- ESCOSA sets revenue determinations
- Brine discharge to Gulf St Vincent licensed by the EPA
instruments.summary_zh:
南澳供水零售商许可与价格监管，包括SA Water的海水淡化资产。
- Lonsdale阿德莱德海水淡化厂，产能1亿立方米/年（100 GL）
- ESCOSA核定收入
- 向St Vincent湾排放浓盐水须持EPA许可

changes.summary_en: Gas reservation scheme revised (10 September): AER to set share up to 20%; start delayed to 1 January 2028; bill expected later in 2026.
changes.summary_zh: 天然气保留机制修订（9月10日）：由AER设定比例、上限20%；起始日推迟至2028年1月1日；法案预计2026年内提交。

changes.summary_en: Statutory reviews of NOPSEMA and NOPTA launched; Offshore Environmental Management Review key findings and next steps published.
changes.summary_zh: NOPSEMA与NOPTA法定评估启动；海上环境管理评估公布主要结论与后续安排。

changes.summary_en: Victoria launched Australia's first offshore wind auction (25 August) for 2 GW off Gippsland; RFP open to August 2027, award expected 2028.
changes.summary_zh: 维州启动全国首轮海上风电拍卖（8月25日），Gippsland外海2 GW；招标开放至2027年8月，预计2028年授标。

changes.summary_en: National Environmental Protection Agency commenced (1 July) with compliance, audit and stop-work order powers.
changes.summary_zh: 国家环保署成立（7月1日），具备合规、审计及停工令权力。

changes.summary_en: Domestic Gas Reservation Scheme announced (7 May): LNG exporters to reserve 20% of exports from 1 July 2027; draft design framework released 27 May.
changes.summary_zh: 国内天然气保留机制宣布（5月7日）：LNG出口商自2027年7月1日起保留出口量的20%；5月27日发布设计框架草案。

changes.summary_en: Final feasibility licences offered to three Bunbury projects (about 4 GW); no licences in Illawarra; preliminary decision not to offer in Bass Strait.
changes.summary_zh: Bunbury三个项目获最终可行性许可证（约4 GW）；Illawarra无许可证；Bass Strait初步决定不发证。

changes.summary_en: Gippsland Skies licence (FL-03) surrendered on 5 January, following Gippsland Dawn (Jul 2025) and Kent (Oct 2025); nine Gippsland licences remain.
changes.summary_zh: Gippsland Skies许可证（FL-03）于1月5日交回，此前Gippsland Dawn（2025年7月）和Kent（2025年10月）已交回；Gippsland剩余9个许可证。

changes.summary_en: EPBC reform package assented (1 December) after passing on 28 November; National Environmental Standards framework commenced 2 December.
changes.summary_zh: EPBC改革法案11月28日通过、12月1日获御准；国家环境标准框架12月2日生效。

changes.summary_en: 2025 Otway offshore petroleum acreage release gazetted (11 December): five areas, two off Victoria and three off Tasmania.
changes.summary_zh: 2025年Otway海上油气区块招标公告（12月11日）：5个区块，维州外海2个、塔州外海3个。

changes.summary_en: OEI fee and levy remittal regulations registered (14 November), waiving or reducing offshore wind licence fees; fees expected to resume in 2027.
changes.summary_zh: OEI费用与征费减免条例登记（11月14日），免除或下调海上风电许可证费，预计2027年恢复。

changes.summary_en: EPBC Amendment (Reconsiderations) Act 2025 passed, shielding Macquarie Harbour salmon farming from reconsideration.
changes.summary_zh: 《2025年EPBC修订（复议）法》通过，使Macquarie Harbour三文鱼养殖免于复议。

changes.summary_en: Southern Ocean feasibility licence granted to Alinta Energy (Spinifex, 1 GW+); Hunter licence for Novocastrian finalised in 2025.
changes.summary_zh: Southern Ocean可行性许可证授予Alinta Energy（Spinifex，1 GW以上）；Hunter区域Novocastrian许可证于2025年落定。

changes.summary_en: Amended OEI Regulations in force: management plans, design notification, financial security, safety zones, WHS and fees.
changes.summary_zh: OEI条例修订生效：管理计划、设计通知、财务担保、安全区、工作健康安全及收费。

changes.summary_en: WA Domestic Gas Policy updated (19 September): onshore reservation 80% to end-2030, then 100%; 15% for offshore LNG unchanged.
changes.summary_zh: 西澳国内天然气政策更新（9月19日）：陆上保留比例2030年底前80%，此后100%；海上LNG 15%不变。

changes.summary_en: Bunbury offshore wind area declared (3,995 km², potential up to 11.4 GW).
changes.summary_zh: Bunbury海上风电区域宣布设立（3,995平方公里，潜在装机最高11.4 GW）。

changes.summary_en: Twelve Gippsland offshore wind projects awarded feasibility licences from 37 applications.
changes.summary_zh: Gippsland 37份申请中12个海上风电项目获可行性许可证。

changes.summary_en: OPGGS Legislation Amendment (Safety and Other Measures) Act 2024 enacted (No. 43 of 2024).
changes.summary_zh: 《2024年OPGGS立法修订（安全及其他措施）法》颁布（2024年第43号）。

changes.summary_en: MEROLA Act 2024 assented (18 June), permanently banning GHG storage in Queensland's Great Artesian Basin.
changes.summary_zh: MEROLA法获御准（6月18日），永久禁止在昆州大自流盆地封存温室气体。

changes.summary_en: WA decided not to implement the Aquatic Resources Management Act 2016; FRMA 1994 and Pearling Act 1990 retained.
changes.summary_zh: 西澳决定不实施《2016年水生资源管理法》，保留《1994年渔业资源管理法》及《1990年珍珠养殖法》。

changes.summary_en: Illawarra offshore wind area declared (Commonwealth waters off Wollongong).
changes.summary_zh: Illawarra海上风电区域宣布设立（Wollongong外海联邦海域）。

changes.summary_en: Future Gas Strategy released (9 May), affirming gas demand to 2050 and support for new supply and CCS.
changes.summary_zh: 《未来天然气战略》发布（5月9日），确认至2050年的天然气需求，支持新增供应和碳捕集与封存。

changes.summary_en: Enabling Offshore Wind Energy Act 2024 passed, legislating 2/4/9 GW offshore wind targets for 2032/2035/2040.
changes.summary_zh: 《推动海上风电》法通过，立法确定2032/2035/2040年海上风电目标2/4/9 GW。

changes.summary_en: WA Petroleum Legislation Amendment passed (7 May), creating a CCS regime onshore and in coastal waters.
changes.summary_zh: 西澳《石油立法修订》通过（5月7日），建立陆上及沿海水域碳捕集与封存制度。

changes.summary_en: NSW Parliament passed the EP&A Amendment (Seabed Mining and Exploration) Bill, banning oil, gas and mineral exploration and extraction in NSW coastal waters.
changes.summary_zh: 新州议会通过EP&A修订（海底采矿与勘探）法案，禁止在新州沿海水域勘探开采油气及矿产。

changes.summary_en: Southern Ocean offshore wind area (about 1,030 km², off Warrnambool and Port Fairy) declared.
changes.summary_zh: Southern Ocean海上风电区域（约1,030平方公里，Warrnambool及Port Fairy外海）宣布设立。

changes.summary_en: Gas Market Code commenced (11 July): A$12/GJ reasonable price for east coast wholesale gas, with exemption pathway.
changes.summary_zh: 天然气市场准则生效（7月11日）：东海岸批发气合理价格12澳元/吉焦，设豁免路径。

changes.summary_en: Reformed Safeguard Mechanism took effect: baselines decline 4.9% a year to 2030; tradable Safeguard Mechanism Credits.
changes.summary_zh: 改革后的保障机制生效：基线每年下降4.9%至2030年；引入可交易的保障机制信用。

changes.summary_en: PRRT deductions cap for LNG projects (90% of assessable receipts) applies from 1 July 2023.
changes.summary_zh: LNG项目PRRT扣除上限（应税收入的90%）自2023年7月1日起适用。

changes.summary_en: Hunter offshore wind area declared off the NSW coast (Commonwealth waters).
changes.summary_zh: Hunter海上风电区域宣布设立（新州外海联邦海域）。

changes.summary_en: ADGSM reformed to quarterly assessment and extended to 1 January 2030.
changes.summary_zh: ADGSM改为按季度评估，有效期延至2030年1月1日。
